front_is_over: one point per architecture, the median perplexity across its replicates. Computed per run instead, a lucky seed could put an architecture on the front while its own replicates sit off it, and membership would describe a seed rather than a design.

why_excluded.other_configuration: measured under a different corpus or token budget. Perplexity on different text, or after four times the training, is not the same quantity — so each configuration gets its own table and its own front.
why_excluded.not_usable_for_benchmark: the run did not meet its token budget, so its perplexity answers a different question than a complete row's
why_excluded.duplicate_fingerprint: the same measurement completed more than once; the latest is kept
